notes: Seed elections page works over https. No Clarity or vendor site found. The county posts Hart PDF reports (Cumulative and Precinct) on its OpenCms site; link hrefs use backslashes, fetched with forward slashes. Last-Modified headers vary per file and look like real upload times. The 8:40 PM runoff cumulative file returned 403, so its content was not read; its county-total nature is inferred from its 'Cumulative Results' name and is supported by the absence of any election-night precinct file. 2024 general undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both LATER (check 2: precinct reports printed and uploaded days after election night), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Confidence low because no report has both a printed run time and upload time on election night.

2024_general.fact: The Previous Election Results page lists for Nov 5, 2024 only 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct' (2024-11/11-05-24 official pct x pct.pdf). Nothing shows what was posted on election night. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Unofficial Precinct Results - All reporting' is a 500-page 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results CHEROKEE COUNTY, TEXAS ... PRIMARY ELECTION ... Run Time 3:30 PM Run Date 03/05/2026', Last-Modified Sat, 07 Mar 2026 03:01:37 GMT (9:01 PM CST Mar 6), both after election night. No earlier precinct file for the primary is listed.

2026_runoff.fact: Election-night links on the Elections page are 'Absentee + Early Voting Totals - 7:00pm' and '8:40pm - All 8 of 8 locations reporting' (both Hart 'Cumulative Results' county totals by file name; the 8:40 PM file returned HTTP 403 to the fetch module). The only runoff precinct file is 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct Results', a 'Precinct Results Report Official Results ... Run Time 3:21 PM ... Run Date 06/01/2026', Last-Modified Fri, 05 Jun 2026 13:47:07 GMT.
